Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so things move through procurement cleanly:

- You noted procurement will likely use a Purchase Requisition (PR) and then a PO (Net 30) rather than a card for the initial purchase.
- You asked whether Redwood is available on marketplaces (AWS/GCP) and whether that would simplify purchasing — short answer: we are available on AWS Marketplace (listing can be used for consolidated billing), but many customers prefer a direct supplier setup for SOW/PO invoicing.

Next steps I recommend:
1) If you want to go the internal PR -> PO route: create the PR with supplier name and details below (legal name, tax ID, billing email). Once PR is approved, procurement should issue a PO to billing@redwood.com.
2) If you prefer marketplace: let me know and I can connect you with marketplace ops to confirm entitlement and pricing flow (may still require a marketplace subscription workflow).
3) If procurement needs vendor setup in Coupa/Ariba: we can provide the W9 and vendor packet; we’ll also create an internal Sales Ops ticket to track supplier onboarding.

Supplier details for PR (please copy into the PR form):
- Supplier name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Address: 2101 Third St, San Francisco, CA 94107
- Tax ID (EIN): 81-2345678
- Billing email: billing@redwood.com

I attached a stub W9 and a short SOW for the trial engagement.

Looping in Dev (Sales Ops) to create a supplier onboarding ticket and Rishi (Finance) for payment/billing questions.
